title: LLM Systems Engineering: Open Field Path
description: A practitioner-maintained field path for designing, controlling, evaluating, and operating verifiable LLM systems, from the model interface to the environment that makes it reliable.
outcomes: Integrate models behind observable, replaceable contracts you own.
Design context, tools, and structured outputs as versioned interfaces.
Build measurable retrieval with citations, abstention, and verifiable provenance.
Engineer a harness that makes the environment legible, safe, and actionable for the model.
Control loops through budgets, stopping criteria, recovery, and idempotency.
Model execution, knowledge, and provenance as evaluable graphs.
Operate LLM systems with observability, cost control, security, and governance.
Prove competence through executable artifacts and a field project.
Treat professional certifications as an optional, separate route.

competencies.label: Foundations and models
competencies.description: Explain transformers, tokenization, inference, and model selection through explicit trade-offs.
competencies.evidence: An executable comparison and a model decision backed by evaluation.

competencies.label: Prompt systems
competencies.description: Treat prompts, schemas, and tools as versioned, testable contracts.
competencies.evidence: A regression dataset and A/B pipeline with explicit criteria.

competencies.label: RAG and retrieval
competencies.description: Design ingestion, chunking, search, reranking, grounding, and RAG evaluation.
competencies.evidence: A measured RAG system with answerable and unanswerable cases, citations, and retrieval metrics.

competencies.label: Agent interfaces
competencies.description: Design tools, MCP, memory, and authority boundaries without delegating control to the model.
competencies.evidence: An agent with three typed tools, explicit permissions, and negative-path tests.

competencies.label: Harness Engineering
competencies.description: Build the environment that supplies context, capabilities, isolation, signals, and evaluations to an agent.
competencies.evidence: A reproducible harness with a capability manifest, sandbox, traces, and isolated evals.

competencies.label: Loop Engineering
competencies.description: Control iterations, budgets, progress, retries, concurrency, stopping, and resumption.
competencies.evidence: A bounded, resumable loop that proves termination, idempotency, and failure recovery.

competencies.label: Graph Engineering
competencies.description: Model execution, knowledge, and provenance graphs with explicit invariants and measurable queries.
competencies.evidence: A hybrid system that connects state, evidence, and decisions without losing provenance.

competencies.label: Evaluation
competencies.description: Separate model, retrieval, and application quality through reproducible evaluations.
competencies.evidence: A regression suite with a baseline, rubric, failed samples, and acceptance gates.

competencies.label: LLMOps
competencies.description: Observe latency, cost, quality, safety, and distribution shifts in production.
competencies.evidence: An operational dashboard, alerts, and an incident runbook.

competencies.label: Safety and governance
competencies.description: Model threats, constrain tools, and apply privacy, guardrails, and auditability.
competencies.evidence: A threat model, prompt-injection test, and verifiable controls.

competencies.label: Product architecture
competencies.description: Make build-vs-buy, cost, reliability, and user-experience decisions.
competencies.evidence: ADRs, cost analysis, and a technical field-project review.

modules.title: Model Interfaces and Foundations
modules.description: Transformers, tokenization, generation, and multi-provider clients treated as replaceable components.
modules.proofOfWork: A multi-provider client with observable tokens, latency, errors, and metadata.

modules.title: Context and Output Contracts
modules.description: Context, instructions, tools, and structured outputs as versioned, evaluable interfaces.
modules.proofOfWork: A contract-evaluation pipeline with a dataset, A/B comparison, and regression gates in CI.

modules.title: Retrieval Engineering
modules.description: Ingestion, embeddings, vector stores, chunking, reranking, grounding, and retrieval evaluation.
modules.proofOfWork: A retrieval system with citations, abstention, traceability, and automated evaluation.

modules.title: Agent and Tool Interfaces
modules.description: Agent patterns, tool use, MCP, memory, and agent collaboration with explicit authority.
modules.proofOfWork: An agent with an MCP server, typed tools, authority boundaries, and complete traces.

modules.title: Harness Engineering
modules.description: Architecture and causal evaluation of harnesses: context, loops, capabilities, sandboxes, the current ecosystem, and reproducible benchmarks.
modules.proofOfWork: An executable harness and causal benchmark of current runtimes, with isolation, traces, injected failures, and reproducible evidence.

modules.title: Loop Engineering
modules.description: Governable execution loops: state, progress, budgets, termination, retries, and resumption.
modules.proofOfWork: A durable loop with multidimensional budgets, verifiable stopping, idempotency, and recovery.

modules.title: Graph Engineering
modules.description: Execution, knowledge, and provenance graphs for LLM systems that must explain what they know and what they did.
modules.proofOfWork: A hybrid system with a state graph, knowledge graph, provenance, and query evaluation.

modules.title: Production Engineering for LLM Systems
modules.description: Observability, continuous evaluation, cost, deployment, security, safety, and governance.
modules.proofOfWork: A deployed system with SLOs, costs, evaluations, and an operational runbook.

modules.title: Field Project
modules.description: A real, bounded, verifiable system integrating decisions, failures, metrics, operations, and public review.
modules.proofOfWork: A defensible system with architecture, evals, traces, costs, a runbook, and a reproducible demo.
